$comment: sf-admin-shell, standard simai.smart-component 1.4 (vocabulary 1.1.5): the frame of an admin screen. Owner decisions C416, C420 (with C322, C328, C329, C338, C342); study ui-control control/research/2026-11-22-admin-shell-study, sample prototypes/admin-shell-study/shell.mjs. The page's parts (sf-alert-bar, sf-admin-menu, sf-header-page, the content) are placed, never drawn by the shell.

width.summary: The content's width (C329): list -- the whole work area; read -- the reading width (--sf-container-1--size-max, 960) at the start, for forms and text.

menu-reserve.summary: The room held for the menu before it has drawn, so the work area does not move when it comes (AM-18): rail -- the rail (56); rail-column -- the rail and the section column (56 + 256), the rail alone when the menu says expected-columns=
(the page's row has no open root) or the person hid the column (the menu's own preference); none -- nothing. The server knows whether the page's section has a column.

product.summary: The product's name in the phone top line («Larena Panel»).

skip-label.summary: The skip link's text; empty is «Перейти к содержимому» in the page's language.

menu-open.summary: Whether the phone menu is open (C322): the menu takes the work area's place below 44rem. Written by the menu button, Escape, a page chosen in the menu, or the page; on a wide screen it changes nothing.
The phone menu opened: by its button or by the action open-menu.

menu-close.summary: The phone menu closed: its button, Escape, a page chosen in the menu (sf-admin-menu-navigate), the window grown past the phone width, the work area focused, or the action close-menu.

open-menu.summary: Opens the phone menu (menu-open); focus goes to the menu's first control. Refused no-menu when the shell holds no menu.

close-menu.summary: Closes the phone menu; focus goes back to the menu button.

focus-content.summary: Moves the focus to the work area (the main landmark) and scrolls it to the top: the skip link does it, and a product after it changed the page without a reload.

relations.name: cl-button-icon
$comment: The phone top line's menu button is sf-button-icon, ghost, the 1 rung;
a tag the shell renders is a tag it fetches. The page's own parts
(the bar, the menu, the head, the content) are found by the Loader where

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript (§5.2): the frame with empty areas the element moves the page's nodes into.

accessibility.x-keys: The skip link is the first stop of Tab; Enter on it focuses the work area. On a phone the menu button opens and closes the menu (Enter, Space); Escape closes it and the focus goes back to the button. The work area is the main landmark, named by the page head's h1.

--sf-admin-shell-stick.x-summary: written by the shell on its frame: the height of what stands at the top (the bar and, on a phone, the top line); a data head sticks at inset-block-start: var(--sf-admin-shell-stick)

x-summary: The frame of an admin screen: the alert bar over everything, the admin menu's column, the page head and the content; the document scrolls, the bar, the menu and on a phone a slim top line stay; the skip link first, the menu's room held before it draws, list or reading width.
x-decisions: shape: a leaf that places the page's own parts. It draws the frame (the skip link, the areas, the phone top line with sf-button-icon) and moves each slotted node into its area once; it never draws or copies the bar, the menu, the head or the content.

scroll (C420): the document scrolls; the bar is sticky at the top, the menu's column sticky under it at the window's height less the bar's, the phone top line sticky under the bar. --sf-admin-shell-stick (written by the shell) is the height that stands at the top, so a data head sticks under it with plain position: sticky.

phone (C322, C342, C420): below 44rem -- the admin menu's own fold -- a slim top line: the menu button, the product, slot top-end (the activity indicator and the bell). The sample folded at 48rem; 44rem is the released menu's threshold, so the two never disagree between 704 and 768.

first paint (AM-18): menu-reserve holds the menu's room until the menu marks data-column; rail-column falls back to the rail when SF.Preferences sf-admin-menu/main says second false, the menu's own store.
names: --sf-admin-shell-background-color and --sf-admin-shell-divider-color take the colour suffix of the public-variable rule (the study wrote --sf-admin-shell-background, -divider-color).

top-end.description: The phone top line's end: the activity indicator and the bell (C342).

forbidden_client_responsibilities: drawing the page head or the menu

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-admin-shell once per admin screen around sf-alert-bar (slot bar), sf-admin-menu (slot menu), sf-header-page (slot head) and the content.
do_not: Do not give the work area its own scroll box: the document scrolls
Do not draw a second skip link or a second main landmark
Do not put the bell or the activity indicator in the content: on a phone they go to slot top-end

accessibility.focus: The skip link first; it focuses the work area (main, tabindex -1, named by the h1). The phone menu button holds aria-expanded and aria-controls; opening moves the focus into the menu, closing back to the button.
